parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of incorrect indentation when using the `prepend` option in the `literalinclude` directive. The change is minimal and focused on preserving the leading whitespace of the included code.

issues.description: The code could be slightly more readable by adding a comment explaining the purpose of the regular expression match.
